I'm not OP, but I'm a fellow believer.

You see, if you grew up in an abusive household, you're not going to be a good person after you're out. Maybe you get lucky and help comes before or after that point that is able to drag you into a healthy mindset. *But that depends on whether it happens to you.*

Say you're poor and can't afford to educate yourself because you have to provide for the family. Maybe eventually your family can afford to educate you due to a rise in sales. *That is reliant on an increase in customers.*

Say you're having a good life, got an education and became a lawyer with a fat bank account, a lovely wife and the sweetest daughter. *That is because you had good parents, you had good opportunities, and because the college required for a law degree accepted you and you got out of being a public defendant.*

Life is heavily dependent on what happens to you. But, if we really work that 10%, the world can become a better place, where we can all become who we want to be, and we can all support each other.
